change_significance.description: Optional. It may only RAISE the level the implementer declared, never lower it.

reviewed_shas.description: REQUIRED. The head SHA you ACTUALLY CHECKED OUT AND READ, per MR. The operator re-reads the live head and REFUSES your verdict if it moved while you were reviewing - anything pushed after your checkout would otherwise merge unreviewed under your approval.

findings.description: Required (>=1) when verdict=request_changes. The OPERATOR posts these as the SCM review and its inline comments - you do not post them yourself.
